# diff.dexli.dev

> A two-pane diff for text and JSON. Paste two pieces of text or two JSON values and see what changed — line-level, word-level, or a structural JSON compare that ignores key order (arrays stay order-sensitive). Free, no signup — diffing happens in your browser.

Part of the dexli.dev tiny-tools family: one tool per subdomain, honest copy, no accounts, no upsell.

## URL state (agent-relevant)

Both panes and the mode serialise into the URL, so you can construct a pre-filled link:

    https://diff.dexli.dev/?a=<urlencoded left>&b=<urlencoded right>&mode=<line|word|json>

- `a` — left pane contents, `b` — right pane contents
- `mode` — `line` (default), `word`, or `json` (structural compare)
- Defaults are omitted: an empty diff is just `https://diff.dexli.dev/`

Example: `https://diff.dexli.dev/?a=hello%20world&b=hello%20there&mode=word`

## Limits

- JSON mode is a value-tree comparison, not a text diff — key order is ignored, array order matters.

## Family

- [dexli.dev](https://dexli.dev/): the family index ([llms.txt](https://dexli.dev/llms.txt))
- [webhook.dexli.dev](https://webhook.dexli.dev/): temporary HTTP inbox for testing webhooks
- [cron.dexli.dev](https://cron.dexli.dev/): cron expression parser and firings preview
- [regex.dexli.dev](https://regex.dexli.dev/): live regex tester with shareable URL state
- [transcript.dexli.dev](https://transcript.dexli.dev/): read LLM .jsonl logs as a conversation
